mailbox.title: My e-mail
mailbox.settings_lead: Connect your own e-mail to read your messages and send from your address inside {brand} — attaching prescriptions, reports and X-ray images directly.
mailbox.connect_sub: Incoming and outgoing mail from your own address.
mailbox.connect_failed: Could not connect to the mailbox
mailbox.password_help: For Gmail and Outlook use an “app password”, not your normal password.
mailbox.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the saved one.
mailbox.how_private: Your mailbox is yours: nobody else in the clinic sees it, not even the owner. The password is stored encrypted.
mailbox.how_clinic: Automatic messages to patients (confirmations, reminders, papers) still go out from the clinic's address. Your e-mail is for the messages you send yourself.
mailbox.app_pw_gmail: Gmail: Google account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords.
mailbox.app_pw_outlook: Outlook / Hotmail: Microsoft account → Security → Advanced security options → App password.
mailbox.app_pw_cpanel: Hosting mail (cPanel): the address and its password, server mail.yourdomain.
mailbox.disconnect_sub: Removes the connection and the password from {brand}; your mailbox itself is not touched.
mailbox.trash_confirm: Move this message to the trash?
mailbox.subject: Subject
mailbox.to_help: One or more addresses, separated by commas.
mailbox.papers_help: Attached as PDFs on the clinic's letterhead (X-ray images as they are).
mailbox.files_help: Up to 10 files, 20 MB in all.

err.MAILBOX_IMAP: Could not open the mailbox. Check the password or the server in My e-mail settings.
err.MAILBOX_IMAP_LOGIN: Signing in to read mail (IMAP) failed.
err.MAILBOX_SMTP_LOGIN: Signing in to send mail (SMTP) failed.
err.MAILBOX_TOO_BIG: The attachments are too big (20 MB at most).
err.MAILBOX_SECRET: The saved password cannot be read any more. Connect the mailbox again.
err.MAIL_HOST_UNKNOWN: The server name was not found.
err.MAIL_HOST_PRIVATE: This server is on a private network and cannot be used.
